prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished grounded fantasy RPG inventory item icon readable at 48 pixels. Square composition, one isolated fish, believable three-dimensional volume, detailed realistic materials and soft studio light from upper left. Full object contained with clear margins, strong silhouette. True transparent alpha background. No plate, stone, floor, scene, drop shadow, text, labels, border, garnish, utensils, cartoon outline or flat vector rendering. Subject: Burnt Trout. One ruined overcooked split trout with head at lower left and tail at upper right. Three-quarter overhead product view, thick but shriveled body curled from excessive cooking, tail and fins curled and brittle, open center consumed by irregular deep charcoal plates with powdery pale grey ash concentrated on raised cracks. A little dark brown dried flesh visible in deep splits. Strong distinct blackened fish silhouette with physically raised blistered crust and readable grey edges. Whole split fish anatomy recognizable, no glowing embers, no smoke, no floating ash, no gore. Render tactile crust sculptural depth and dry ash variation, not simply a black recolor of fresh fish.
sourceLookup: The genuine fish_trout GLB was rendered with material shading and inspected. Final Luna max critic rejected that source as flat and low detail; it did not meet the polished grounded item icon standard. This generated replacement follows that concrete source-render rejection.
review: Root accepted after fresh Luna max critic approved source and 48px readability. All nine fish passed production inventory lab: loaded 48px rasters, no SVG fallback, matching hover, no errors. Root inspected lab screenshot. Evidence: test-results/icon-fish-final/lab-icons.json and test-results/icon-fish-final/lab-icons.png. Accepted 2026-09-10.
